key.name: last-camera-facing
key.summary: The facing last used: back, front or external

key.name: last-camera-id
key.summary: The libcamera id of the camera last used (empty: the main camera of last-camera-facing)

key.name: lens-labels
key.summary: Ordered lens bar labels by libcamera camera id

key.name: hidden-cameras
key.summary: Camera ids left out of the lens bar (the OV02B1B depth sensor is a mono 2 MP helper, not a lens)

key.name: tuning
key.summary: Gamma, contrast and saturation per camera id

key.name: last-camera-mode
key.summary: The mode last used: photo, video, qr or night

key.name: last-grid-mode
key.summary: The grid: off, 3x3, 4x4 or golden

key.name: last-mic-mode
key.summary: Record sound with videos (MIC ON)

key.name: photo-flash-mode
key.summary: The flash in photo mode: off, on (the torch for the shot) or torch

key.name: video-flash-mode
key.summary: The flash in video mode: off or torch

key.name: timer-mode
key.summary: The self-timer in seconds: 0, 3 or 10

key.name: aspect-ratio
key.summary: The photo aspect ratio: 4:3 or 16:9

key.name: video-quality
key.summary: The video size: 720p or 1080p (what the phone's encoder holds)

key.name: force-torch-help-shown
key.summary: The flash button's long press was explained (or used)

key.name: bright-screen
key.summary: Bright screen: locks brightness to 100 %

key.name: save-location
key.summary: Save location data: unset (ask once), on or off

key.name: shutter-sound
key.summary: Play a sound on capture

key.name: leveler
key.summary: Show the leveler

key.name: volume-buttons-action
key.summary: The volume keys: shutter, focus, mic-mute, zoom, default or nothing

key.name: volume-buttons-invert
key.summary: Swap volume up and down (for zoom)

key.name: photo-ffc-mirror
key.summary: Save front camera photos as they appear in the preview

key.name: video-mirror-mode
key.summary: Mirror videos: off, on or front (front facing camera only)
